name: Gisela João
description: Gisela João performs at Teatro Municipal Constantino Nery, celebrating 12 years of her career. She will present her album "Inquieta" in 2025, which pays tribute to various authors and composers.
longDescription:
Gisela João performs at Teatro Municipal Constantino Nery on November 14, 2026, at 22:00. The show has a duration of 75 minutes with no interval, and doors open at 21:50. This event celebrates 12 years of her career, highlighting her artistic authenticity and freedom.

Her discography includes "Gisela João" (2013), "Nua" (2016), and "AuRora" (2021). In 2025, she will release "Inquieta," an album produced by Michael League and recorded at Estúdios Carmo. It features songs by artists like José Afonso, Sérgio Godinho, Capicua, and José Mário Branco, exploring themes of freedom, identity, and memory.

Tickets are priced at €12.50 for a full price ticket. Discounts are available for groups of 10 or more (20% off), people with disabilities (50% off), and university students under the "Corredor Cultural" protocol (50% off). An accompanying person for a disabled individual can receive a complimentary ticket by contacting the venue.
